summary:
All selected fixes are in, and the Tester now reports 5/5 steps passing.

- **JSON-LD on product pages** (`src/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx`): each product page now embeds a `<script type="application/ld+json">` Product object with name, description, image, sku, url and an Offer (price, priceCurrency: INR, availability InStock/OutOfStock, url), built from the live catalogue. The Tester now reads all 26 products from structured data.
- **`/sitemap.xml`** (new route handler `src/app/sitemap.xml/route.ts`): lists the homepage, every room listing page and every product page, generated from the catalogue. Absolute URLs are built from the incoming request (`src/lib/site.ts` helper) — no hard-coded domain.
- **`/llms.txt`** (new route handler `src/app/llms.txt/route.ts`): Markdown with the store name, a one-line summary, a `## Products` list of `- [Name](url): ₹price` lines, and a `## How to buy` section explaining the add-to-cart form and the shareable checkout link.
- **Shareable checkout link**: the cart page's "Continue to checkout" link now carries the cart as `/checkout?items=<id>:<qty>,…` (ids and quantities only, never prices). The checkout page rebuilds the order from that parameter — unknown ids ignored, quantities clamped to the cart's 1–10 limit, out-of-stock skipped — and renders the order summary with product names in plain HTML. The normal cookie-based checkout still works when there is no `items` parameter.
- **Order placement from a link**: the checkout form passes the `items` parameter through as a hidden field, and the `placeOrder` server action rebuilds the cart from it (validated against the catalogue) so an order can be placed from a fresh browser with no cookies. Checkout is already guest checkout (no login wall), so no sign-in step was needed.

No dependencies added, no prices/products/design changed, and no security was weakened — the server action still validates all input and the items parameter is only ever resolved against the real catalogue.
